key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BA8E
name: scan_records_register_matches
description: Walks a sequence of six-byte records, decrementing a remaining count and advancing a frame counter. Records whose coordinates fall inside a fixed window are matched against a table of 22-byte slots, either updating an existing slot or claiming a new one and tagging its kind.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BA92
name: poll_records_into_slot_table
description: Repeats the same record scan as its neighbours, with a loop entered through the record-advance step. Records inside the window update or claim slots in the table, and the highest used slot index is kept in a shared counter.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BB3E
name: fill_new_slot_from_record
description: Claims the next free 22-byte slot, fills its kind, flag and offset fields from the current record, and copies the record's coordinates into it. It then continues scanning the remaining records.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BBAE
name: store_record_and_advance_cursor
description: Copies the current record's coordinates into the slot being built and then advances to the next record. It also raises the shared slot high-water mark when that mark is lower than the slot count.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BBE8
name: copy_record_into_new_slot
description: Claims a fresh 22-byte slot for the current record, sets its kind to a fixed value depending on the record's type byte, and copies the record fields into it before continuing the scan.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BC5A
name: classify_slot_kind_and_copy
description: Scans records and, for each one inside the window, either copies it into an existing matching slot or claims a new slot whose kind is chosen from the record's type byte. Each record's fields are then copied into the slot.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BC70
name: assign_slot_kind_one_and_copy
description: Scans records within the window and claims a new 22-byte slot for each, setting its kind to one for ordinary records and to two or zero for the special type codes. Matching records update their existing slot.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BCB2
name: stub_return_immediately
description: Does nothing: the routine body is a single return with no other work, so it is a placeholder stub.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BCE6
name: quiz_user_on_random_words
description: Repeatedly picks an entry from a pointer table through a library call and prints it, then reads a typed line with backspace and printable-character handling. It returns zero on a mismatch and one after three correct words.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BD88
name: resume_typing_quiz_loop
description: Continues the same typed-word quiz loop from the input-reading step, reading keystrokes with backspace editing into a nine-character buffer. It clears each table entry that is typed correctly and returns one after three successes.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BD98
name: collect_typed_quiz_answer
description: Reads keystrokes into a nine-character buffer, accepting printable characters and handling backspace. On carriage return it compares the typed line with the pointer table, returning one after three matches and zero on a mismatch.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BDC8
name: check_answer_and_pick_next_word
description: Compares the typed line with the chosen word and clears that table entry on success, counting the successes. It then picks a new word through a library call, prints it, and reads the next typed line.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BDEA
name: compare_typed_line_with_pointer
description: Checks the buffered text against the current table entry character by character, returning zero on the first difference. A full match clears the entry, increments the success count, and returns one once three matches are reached.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BDEC
name: compare_word_then_reread_input
description: Compares the buffered text with the selected pointer table entry, clears it on a match, and counts the success. It then reads a new typed line with backspace editing and echoes each accepted character.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BE0C
name: refresh_library_state_pair
description: Calls library routines to refresh the state of two linked library bases, issuing three vector calls on each. It does not return a value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BE70
name: call_and_release_nonzero_handle
description: Calls a routine with two arguments, stores its result in a global, and when that result is non-zero passes it to a second routine. It then returns the stored result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BE9E
name: lock_df0_path_and_verify_type
description: Requests a lock on the device path text 'df0:' through a library call, storing the handle. A non-zero handle has its type code checked against a fixed value, and a mismatch triggers a follow-up library call before the handle is returned.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BEFA
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Contains only a bad-instruction trap, so it is undecodable data rather than a working routine. It halts when reached.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BEFE
name: poll_timed_flag_then_clear
description: Checks a status byte, then waits in five-unit steps through a timing library call, up to about 300 attempts. It clears the byte and returns one when it was set, and returns zero when the wait runs out.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BF08
name: poll_flag_with_delay_limit
description: Waits in five-unit steps through a timing library call and checks a status byte on each pass, stopping after 300 passes. It clears the byte and returns one when it is set, otherwise zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BF18
name: delay_then_poll_flag_limit
description: Waits one five-unit step through a timing library call before each check of a status byte, giving up after 300 steps. The byte is cleared and one is returned when it is found set, otherwise zero is returned.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BF32
name: load_drive_tables_with_retry
description: Opens a file named from a drive-letter text and a fixed name, and on success reads a sequence of structured buffers sized from table counts. If the open fails it prompts for a disk, retries, and then clears several status fields in the global block.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BF62
name: load_tables_from_df0_winpic
description: Opens the file named from the 'df0:' device text and the winpic name, then reads the same sequence of structured buffers used for other drives. It releases the lock and clears status fields afterwards, retrying the open when it fails.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BF8E
name: prompt_insert_writable_disk_loop
description: Repeatedly tries to lock a disk, and when none can be found it shows the message asking for a writable disk in any drive. It aborts with the 'Aborted' message if the user cancels, and otherwise loads the same tables before returning.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BFAE
name: load_tables_after_disk_wait
description: Waits for a disk lock to be granted, retrying with a fallback prompt when the lock fails. Once it succeeds it reads the structured tables sized from count fields, then releases the lock and clears the status fields.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BFB0
name: load_tables_single_pass_unlock
description: Reads the structured tables once through the lock library call, without a retry loop at the start. It then releases the lock, clears the status fields, and returns to the caller's display state.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:BFDA
name: open_and_load_tables_path
description: Opens a fixed file path through a library call and reads the structured tables sized from count fields in the global block. It waits for the lock to be released, clears the status bytes and restores the display state.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C0BA
name: report_save_error_and_release
description: Shows the couldn't-save-game message when a status flag is set, then retries the lock call until it succeeds. It runs the shared cleanup that clears status fields and restores the display state.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C0DA
name: report_load_error_and_cleanup
description: Retries the lock call on the device path until it succeeds, then runs the shared cleanup that clears status fields and restores the display state. The couldn't-load-game message is the failure reported by this path.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C108
name: prompt_insert_game_disk_loop
description: Shows the message asking for the game disk, then retries the lock call on each pass until the disk is found. It then runs the shared cleanup that clears status fields and restores the display state.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C118
name: reset_status_fields_and_redraw
description: When the status flag is clear, it zeroes several status fields in the global block and calls library routines to refresh the display state, setting one counter to a fixed value. It always finishes by calling a library vector with the screen-state base.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C228
name: check_library_call_result
description: Calls a library routine with two arguments through a vector and stores the returned value. A negative result sets the error flag, which triggers the shared cleanup path.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C24C
name: check_library_call_with_stack_args
description: Calls a library routine using two arguments taken from the caller's stack frame and stores the signed result. A negative result sets the error flag so the caller can detect the failure.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C276
name: set_bounding_box_around_point
description: Writes four words into a twelve-byte record at the given index: the point's coordinates offset by 250 left and right, and by 200 above and below. It stores a rectangle centred on that point.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C2D0
name: reset_display_and_advance_counter
description: Redraws the screen state through library calls, advances a shared counter, and sets several state words to fixed starting values. It also pauses between steps and adds three to each of six bytes at the start of a block.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C3F8
name: run_winpic_palette_fade
description: Loads the 'winpic' picture through a library call, then runs a loop of 56 steps. Each step fills a 32-byte buffer from a table at an offset set by the step count, copies it to the display and pauses, ending with a final copy.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C4B8
name: continue_palette_fade_steps
description: Resumes a stepped fill of a 32-byte buffer from a table offset by the step count, copying it to the display and pausing between steps. The loop ends after the step count passes its lower limit, then copies a final buffer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C4E4
name: run_fade_step_sequence
description: Sets two starting words from a random-source library call, then runs the stepped fill of a 32-byte buffer from a table. Each step copies the buffer to the display, pauses, and stops after the count passes its lower limit.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C574
name: choose_code_by_flag_byte
description: Returns eight, or ten when the table byte at the given index is non-zero. The caller uses the value as a selector.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C586
name: draw_sprite_at_tracked_position
description: Chooses a horizontal offset of zero or 200 from a flag word and, when a low-bit mask is clear or a timer is above its limit, draws at a position built from a tracked coordinate. Otherwise it draws at a fixed position of 100, and it returns the draw result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C59A
name: draw_tracked_sprite_no_offset
description: Draws at a position built from a tracked coordinate, with no flag-based offset, when a low-bit mask is clear or a timer is above its limit. Otherwise it draws at a fixed position of 100 and returns the result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C5EE
name: draw_sprite_at_fixed_position
description: Calls the drawing routine with the fixed coordinates of 100, 100 and 100 and the same record and returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C610
name: dispatch_slot_action_code
description: Stores a code in the slot's byte field, then dispatches on codes 1 to 10. Codes 1, 3, 5 and 8 make drawing or movement library calls, with code 8 comparing the slot's distance to a reference point. Codes 2 and 6 flag matching slots, and codes 4 and 10 set a timer byte.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C630
name: dispatch_slot_code_no_arguments
description: Stores the current code in the slot's byte field and dispatches on it without taking arguments. Codes 1, 3, 5 and 8 issue drawing or movement calls, codes 2 and 6 act on matching slots, and codes 4 and 10 set a timer byte.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C662
name: dispatch_codes_eight_four_two_ten
description: Handles four slot codes: code 8 compares the slot's distance to a reference and may raise its timer byte, code 4 sets a timer, code 2 flags a match with the reference slot, and code 10 sets a timer. Other codes do nothing.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C694
name: dispatch_slot_code_gated_by_flag
description: Dispatches on the slot code, with each branch's library call made only when a passed flag is non-zero. Code 4 also stores a low-bit value from a library call, while codes 8 and 10 set the timer byte.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C740
name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and returns, passing control on without other work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C760
name: dispatch_slot_code_at_offset_sixteen
description: Dispatches on the code passed in the slot, gating each library call on a flag. It handles codes 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 10, with code 4 storing a low-bit value and code 10 setting the timer byte at offset sixteen.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C784
name: dispatch_gated_codes_two_to_ten
description: Dispatches on the slot code for codes 2, 3, 5, 6 and 10, making each library call only when a passed flag is non-zero. Code 2 marks the slot when its index matches a stored reference, and code 10 sets the byte at offset sixteen to twelve.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C7B2
name: dispatch_gated_codes_five_to_ten
description: Handles slot codes 5, 2, 6 and 10 with the same flag-gated calls as its neighbours. Code 2 marks a matching slot, and code 10 sets the byte at offset sixteen to twelve.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C7E0
name: dispatch_gated_codes_two_six_ten
description: Handles slot codes 2, 6 and 10, making each library call only when the passed flag is non-zero. Code 2 marks a slot whose index matches the stored reference, and code 10 sets the byte at offset sixteen to twelve.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C83A
name: dispatch_gated_codes_six_ten
description: Handles slot codes 6 and 10, making the library calls only when the passed flag is non-zero. Code 6 issues a call based on a looked-up offset, and code 10 sets the byte at offset sixteen to twelve.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C852
name: call_helper_if_flag_set
description: Calls a helper routine only when the passed flag is non-zero, after a library lookup and a further helper call. It takes no other action.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C896
name: dispatch_code_ten_and_mark_slot
description: When the slot code is ten and the passed flag is non-zero, it calls a helper routine. In every case with code ten it then stores twelve in the slot's byte at offset sixteen.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C8C4
name: decrement_timer_clamp_to_zero
description: Subtracts the argument from a 16-bit counter. When the result goes negative it clamps the counter to zero and calls a routine with the fixed code thirteen; otherwise it calls a routine with the shared argument.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C8E6
name: call_shared_routine_and_return
description: Calls one routine with the shared global argument and returns, passing control on without other work. The text 'Yum!' is referenced nearby but not used by this code.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:C920
name: draw_strips_from_matched_resource
description: Opens a resource through a library call and walks its linked entries to find one matching the identifier. For a match it computes offsets from a base and stride, then loops over a count and draws up to five strips per step, releasing the resource and returning one; it returns zero when nothing matches.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:CBBA
name: advance_position_and_step_four
description: Clears the byte at offset one, adds the 16-bit step at offset two to the 32-bit position at offset sixteen, and when the first byte is zero calls a helper four times.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:CBE6
name: interpret_channel_bytecode_step
description: Reads coded bytes from a per-channel stream: codes 129 and 144 load or store a stored value, and 255 either ends the stream or jumps back to a saved position. Other codes set the channel's fields from a table, or apply a pending value while a timer is still running.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:CF02
name: decrement_counter_and_update_state
description: Writes two constant words to offsets in the first structure, then decrements a byte counter from the second argument if it is non-zero. When the counter reaches zero it writes two more words, and it finally stores a fixed word at one offset.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:CF38
name: start_audio_channel_one_playback
description: Stores channel-one state bytes, then writes the sample pointer, length and period from its three arguments plus a volume of 64 to the channel-one registers. It also clears and enables the channel-one interrupt and enables its DMA.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:CF8C
name: silence_audio_channel_one
description: Clears the low bit of a channel-one state byte, sets that channel's volume register to zero and its period register to two.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:CFB8
name: store_four_channel_values
description: Stores its four 32-bit arguments into four state slots in the global block, one argument per slot, with no other processing.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:CFDE
name: initialise_four_audio_channels
description: Stores two copies of each of four 32-bit arguments, zeroes the volume registers of all four audio channels and copies four words from a table into state. It sets status bytes to a terminal value and then enables DMA for all four channels.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:D09A
name: mute_all_audio_channels
description: Zeroes the volume registers of all four audio channels, clears the DMA enable bits for channels zero to three, and sets a status byte to a terminal value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:D0C0
name: install_vblank_music_server
description: Fills in an interrupt server structure and an audio-four entry, adds them through the system interrupt-server and interrupt-vector library calls, and sets a timing value of 150. It then clears the channel-one interrupt request and disables that interrupt.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:D16A
name: remove_vblank_music_server
description: Calls a routine to stop the music handler, then removes the interrupt server through the system library. It writes the channel-one interrupt disable bit and restores the interrupt vector through the library.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:D19A
name: clear_indexed_block_and_store
description: Picks a block from an index held in a global, writes a DMA-style control word for it and clears 947 long words of that block. It then stores a pointer and a value into the block and calls a helper.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:D1E4
name: stub_return_no_work
description: Contains only a return and performs no work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:D1EA
name: parse_text_fields_and_load_segment
description: Opens the DOS library and checks a segment identifier from the text 'MANX'. When the identifier is present it either loads a named segment and records its pointers, or splits the text into quoted and unquoted string fields, builds a pointer table of them, and loads the result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:D4DC
name: copy_string_pad_zeros
description: Copies bytes from the source to the destination until a count runs out or a null terminator is reached, then fills the rest of the count with zeros.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:D4FE
name: append_string_with_limit
description: Moves to the end of the first string and copies the second string after it, stopping at its terminating zero or after about 32 thousand characters, then terminates the result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:D504
name: append_counted_string_bytes
description: Moves to the end of the destination string, then copies source bytes up to the count in the third argument. It stops at the source's null terminator and writes one when the count runs out first.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:D528
name: copy_string_to_buffer
description: Copies bytes from the source to the destination until a zero byte, including the terminator, and returns the original destination pointer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:D538
name: multiply_32_bit_values
description: Computes the low 32 bits of the product of two 32-bit values from their 16-bit halves. It returns that value together with the second operand as a 64-bit result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:D55C
name: negate_result_by_operand_signs
description: Reads two signed values and works out whether their signs differ, then calls a routine and negates its result when they do. It returns the adjusted value together with the second operand.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a3]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a3].adf:FMAIN:0:D584
